text:
Gold Price in 1996
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1996, the LBMA gold price fell 9.0% between 1996-01-31 ($406) and 1996-12-30 ($369). The highest sampled price was $406 in January and the lowest was $369 in December. The mean of these observations was $386. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
